requiredBehaviors.behavior: keep scientific opinion consultation and notified-body conformity decision as separate externally verified states
requiredBehaviors.evidence: Opinion is not certificate and the authority boundary keeps EMA/NCA opinion separate from NB conformity decision.

requiredBehaviors.behavior: keep sponsor NB EMA correspondence and current procedural snapshots out of global durable memory
requiredBehaviors.evidence: The Memory Path excludes concrete sponsor, NB and EMA communication and volatile procedure snapshots.

forbiddenBehaviors.behavior: turn a planned or positive scientific opinion into a simulated CE certificate
forbiddenBehaviors.evidence: The skill explicitly prohibits equating scientific opinion with the NB certification decision.

forbiddenBehaviors.behavior: persist confidential product-development or current consultation state as timeless memory
forbiddenBehaviors.evidence: Concrete medicinal-product development and consultation state remain run-only or controlled regulatory records.
